about: #80's second held-out set: written by an independent sub-agent from the decided meanings only, to put a grammar of rules in trouble. Created on Friday 2026-10-02 at 10:00, local time, unless 'created' says otherwise. Expectations as decided in #89-#92: phrases that were 'unclear' in #80 and have a meaning now say so in 'basis'. Format in tests/unit/core/test_meanings.py.
